mild H1N influenza infection can cause abnormal pulmonary function in patients.

(a) pulmonary function abnormalities and respiratory tract infections are common one-year after mild influenza H1N1; (b) these abnormalities are not related to the severity of the original influenza H1N11; (c) these abnormalities can be improved by rehabilitation therapy.
